title: Bot PR creation and reuse paths must apply the auto-rerun label on every path
answers: Why are Dependabot, uv.lock or model catalog PRs not auto-retried after CI failures?
How do I make an automated PR eligible for CI retries?
Where is the auto-rerun label applied to bot PRs?
body:
Invariant: eligibility is decided by the `auto-rerun` label at the time the sweep runs, so each bot-PR path must set it both when creating a PR and when reusing an existing one.
Enforced by: .github/dependabot.yml (labels list on the update entry), .github/workflows/update-model-catalog.yml (`gh pr create --label auto-rerun` and `gh pr edit "$existing_pr" --add-label auto-rerun`), .github/workflows/uv.yml (`gh pr edit "$NUMBER" --add-label auto-rerun` on the reuse path and `--add-label team-review --add-label auto-rerun` on the create path).
What breaks: a path that creates but does not label (or only labels on create) leaves reused PRs outside the retry sweep.
Constraints: On the uv.yml create path the label is added after the existing `sleep 5`, which keeps the delayed-labeling behavior. The reuse path adds the label without that sleep. The repository label must be created first with the description "Automatically rerun eligible failed CI runs (up to 3 retries)."
Applies: Only the Dependabot, uv.lock and model-catalog automation in this repository; human-opened PRs need the label applied manually.
applies: Bot-generated PR automation in .github/ workflows and Dependabot config; not the retry sweep itself.
says: Automated dependency update pull requests are not automatically retried after CI failures.
Reused bot pull requests for model catalog updates miss automated CI retry runs.
Automatically rerun failing continuous integration checks on bot-generated pull requests.
Updated lockfile pull requests lack the auto-retry tag when an existing PR is updated.
Ensure all automated bot pull requests qualify for automatic test retries on failure.
search: Bot-generated pull request automation must apply the auto-rerun label on both PR creation and PR reuse paths to remain eligible for CI retries. This is enforced across .github/dependabot.yml, .github/workflows/update-model-catalog.yml (using gh pr create and gh pr edit), and .github/workflows/uv.yml (also adding team-review). The create path in uv.yml adds the label after a 5-second sleep while the reuse path adds it immediately; the label requires description 'Automatically rerun eligible failed CI runs (up to 3 retries)', and human PRs require manual labeling.
